newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil Brahma begun as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil Brahma begun as buy.

text.p: ING Barings said in a report it had initiated coverage of Brazilian brewer Brahma with a buy recommendation.
- Marla Marron, head of Latin American Food and Beverage Research, said Brahma shares trade at a discount to the sector, despite its strong domestic and regional position.
- She expects this discount to narrow next year as the company's earnings per ADR increase by 15 percent year-on-year in 1998 on the domestic beverage industry rebound.
- ING Barings set the Brahma's 12-month target price at $20 per ADR, showing a 36.8 percent potential price appreciation.
- Brahma preferred shares was up 0.63 percent at 795 reais at 1455 local/1755 GMT on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
